WITH trans_avg AS (
  SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) as avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY transref
),
overall_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) as overall_avg
  FROM trans_avg
),
kept_trans AS (
  SELECT ta.transref, ta.avg_anlycount
  FROM trans_avg ta, overall_avg_val oa
  WHERE ta.avg_anlycount > oa.overall_avg
),
kept_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) as kept_avg
  FROM kept_trans
)
SELECT 
  kt.transref,
  kt.avg_anlycount,
  kt.avg_anlycount - oav.overall_avg as diff_from_overall,
  kt.avg_anlycount - kav.kept_avg as diff_from_kept
FROM kept_trans kt, overall_avg_val oav, kept_avg_val kav
ORDER BY diff_from_kept DESC
LIMIT 10;
